Sunrise About Careers Sunrise About Careers About Careers Media Assets Contact Privacy & Legal © 2025 Sunrise Robotics Intelligent robotics transforming manufacturing. Sunrise is a new kind of robotics company. We don’t just build robots — we shape the future of manufacturing. Our intelligent, autonomous robotic cells transform existing manufacturing processes, effortlessly scale capacity, and empower manufacturers to redeploy their operators to the most valuable tasks. Mission Sunrise is on a mission to augment humanity through intelligent robotics. We’re starting with industrial manufacturing, a key catalyst of human progress. Everything we touch and use in our daily lives is manufactured, yet the industry and our economies face growing challenges—labor shortages, the need for greater flexibility, and rising supply chain risks.
